example_sentences_in_bangla: তোমার মহাভারত শোনার সময় নেই এখন।
এটা একটা পুরো মহাভারতের মতো জটিল ব্যাপার।
example_sentences_in_english: I don't have time to hear your Mahabharata right now.
This is a complicated matter like the entire Mahabharata.
history: The Mahabharata is one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India, attributed to the sage Vyasa, narrating the dynastic struggle between the Pandavas and Kauravas culminating in the Kurukshetra War, composed around 400 BCE to 400 CE.
note: The idiom draws directly from the epic's reputation for its immense length and complexity, often used to dismiss lengthy explanations.
